title: City Cruises Philadelphia: Signature Dinner Cruise with Buffet
includes: Delicious dinner buffet attended by server, with freshly prepared entrees, salads and desserts
Unlimited coffee, hot tea, and iced tea
Onboard entertainment and DJ music for fun from start to finish
Spectacular views of the Philadelphia skyline and waterfront landmarks
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Infants aged 2 years and under are free of charge (meal not included).
Seating is only guaranteed together for the number of tickets confirmed on this voucher. Reservations may not be combined.
Dress code: We encourage casual attire that is informal and comfortable, (khakis, nice jeans, dresses, casual button-ups/blouses) for your day on the water.
Boarding begins 30 minutes prior to departure. Guests must arrive early, as late arrivals will likely miss the boat.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Grab your friends or that special someone and get ready for three hours of fun on the waters of Philadelphia! This dinner cruise includes amazing DJ entertainment and views of the magnificent skyline. Enjoy a chef-prepared buffet dinner from the interior climate-controlled dining decks and gaze upon Philadelphia's twinkling lights from the exterior outer deck.

Departing from Penn’s Landing, a dinner cruise on the Delaware River lets you relax and enjoy the beauty of Philly’s historic waterfront.
